sources.label: Unofficial FairEmail Morphe patches for 1.2337 and 1.2338 (experimental Pro and
sources.author: FairEmail
patch_list: Install patched FairEmail alongside the official app using the same .morphe package suffix as Morphe's Clone app. Do NOT select Morphe's separate Clone app simultaneously.
Make FairEmail's local Pro feature checks return true. No purchases or signing changes. Does not preserve stock-install data across a signature mismatch.
Permit the built-in encrypted account/settings export dialog. Does not grant other Pro features. Re-signed APK cannot access an existing official installation's data.
Enable OAuth setup in re-signed FairEmail (experimental)
Enable both Gmail and provider OAuth setup menu paths without modifying global signature checks. Google authorization is not guaranteed.
Hide the FairEmail support/Pro message above the inbox without affecting mail, notifications, or Pro features.
Prevent the startup changelog pop-up without deleting the changelog or changing the first-run welcome dialog.
